exercise.name: Dumbbell Thruster

reference.title: Dumbbell Thruster
reference.listing: Video; data sheet: body part Shoulders; Thighs, equipment Dumbbell, exercise type Strength

exercise.mechanics: Compound (hip, knee, ankle, shoulder and elbow)

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace at the top, squat down; breathe out as you drive up and press; breathe in again as the dumbbells come back to the shoulders.
breathing.cadence: About 1.4 s down, 1 s up and press, about 1 s back to the shoulders

prescription.tempo: Controlled squat, fast drive and press
prescription.progression: Heavier dumbbells, more reps per set, then timed sets for conditioning. Dumbbell load is user-chosen: pick a weight that leaves about 2-3 reps in reserve (RPE 7-8) at the end of each set.

cues.text: Dumbbells on the front of the shoulders, palms in, elbows forward. Feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Breathe in, brace and front squat until the hip crease is just below the knees; heels down.
Chest up, elbows up, knees out over the toes.
Drive the floor away; let the leg drive pop the dumbbells off the shoulders, then press straight up past the face.
Arms straight overhead, biceps by the ears, ribs down; breathe out.
Bring the dumbbells back to the shoulders before the next squat.

mistakes.mistake: Pressing before the legs have finished driving
mistakes.fix: Wait for the hips and knees to extend; the arms take over from the leg drive (CrossFit 2019).

mistakes.mistake: Arching the low back at lockout
mistakes.fix: Brace the ribs down; finish with the dumbbells over the middle of the feet.

mistakes.mistake: Starting the next squat with the dumbbells still overhead
mistakes.fix: Bring them back to the shoulders first, then squat (CrossFit 2019).
Keep the elbows forward so the dumbbells stay on the shoulders.

kinematics.norm: About shoulder width, toes slightly out (CrossFit 2019)
Hip crease just below the top of the knees at the bottom (CrossFit 2019)
Fairly upright under the front load (Gullett 2009); neutral spine (CrossFit 2019)
Arms fully extended overhead, the load stacked over the hips and ankles (CrossFit 2019)
The press starts after the hips and knees have extended (CrossFit 2019)
Controlled squat, fast drive and press (clinical opinion)

sources.title: CrossFit 2019, The Thruster (CrossFit Essentials, coaching article, 12 April 2019)
Gullett, Tillman, Gutierrez & Chow 2009, a biomechanical comparison of back and front squats in healthy trained individuals (J Strength Cond Res 23(1):284-292; PubMed 19002072)
Straub and Powers 2024, a biomechanical review of the squat exercise: implications for clinical practice (Int J Sports Phys Ther)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness or giving-way occurs.
Choose a dumbbell load you can control for every rep; the load is user-chosen.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Clear space around and above you; do not lock out a dumbbell you cannot control overhead.
modify: Shoulder discomfort overhead: press to the forehead only or switch to a front squat.
Knee pain: squat to a box or a shallower depth.
regressions: Dumbbell front squat and a separate standing press.

muscleNotes.quads_r: Drive the squat out of the bottom; the leg drive pops the dumbbells off the shoulders (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.quads_l: Drive the squat out of the bottom; the leg drive pops the dumbbells off the shoulders (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Hip extensor out of the bottom of the front squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Hip extensor out of the bottom of the front squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Presses the dumbbells overhead once the legs have extended (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Presses the dumbbells overhead once the legs have extended (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_r: Lifts the elbows up and out as the dumbbells pass the head (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_l: Lifts the elbows up and out as the dumbbells pass the head (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Straighten the elbows to lock the dumbbells out overhead.
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Straighten the elbows to lock the dumbbells out overhead.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Rotate and lift the shoulder blades so the arms can finish overhead; "shoulders drive up toward the bar" (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Rotate and lift the shoulder blades so the arms can finish overhead; "shoulders drive up toward the bar" (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Rotates the shoulder blades upward at lockout (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Rotates the shoulder blades upward at lockout (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.adductors_r: Assist hip extension out of the deep squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Assist hip extension out of the deep squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Assist hip extension and steady the knee (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Assist hip extension and steady the knee (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.calves_r: Finish the leg drive and steady the shins (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.calves_l: Finish the leg drive and steady the shins (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.core: Keeps the trunk neutral in the squat and stops the low back arching at lockout (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Hold the chest up in the front squat under the front load (Gullett 2009).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Hold the chest up in the front squat under the front load (Gullett 2009).
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Grip the dumbbell handles; the hands stay closed all set (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Grip the dumbbell handles; the hands stay closed all set (clinical opinion).
